title: Station W Western Area - Lai Tsai Kung

page_data.en:
(C.I.D.) Office Notes
File No.
Confidential
August 12, 1929
Sir,
Rumours are current
that Lai Tsai Ping King 賴財炳京
a Pang leader and notorious
gambler, a close friend of Poo
Yuet Ping, has spent $5000
through one Hau Fok Pau 許福宝
(a professional gambler who
has large acquaintances amongst
Chinese officials and Chinese
Detectives of the French Police and
S.M.P.) in an endeavour to secure
the release of Zao Zai Hoi 趙仔海
(a follower of Pangking) who is now
facing a charge of armed abduction
at the Provincial Court.
He is also wanted for 2 murders
committed at Hung Chum O.O.S.
and negotiations are being
made with the Chinese authorities
for his transfer to the latter.
J.R.
AUG 19
C.I. O.C.S.
Stan Rawling
Central Asst
page_data.zh:
（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记
档案号
机密
1929年8月12日
先生，
现有谣言称，帮会头目兼臭名昭著的赌徒赖财炳京（Lai Tsai Ping King），系浦岳平（Poo Yuet Ping）的密友，已通过许福宝（Hau Fok Pau）（一名职业赌徒，在中国官员以及法国警察队和上海公共租界警务处的中国侦探中拥有广泛人脉）花费5000元，试图谋求正在省法院面临武装绑架指控的赵仔海（Zao Zai Hoi）（帮会成员）获释。
此人还因在虹口特别区犯下的两起谋杀案而被通缉，目前正与中国当局协商将其移交给后者事宜。
J.R.
8月19日
刑事侦缉处处长
斯坦·罗林（Stan Rawling）
中央助理

page_data.en:
（印：Crime Squad / Sn. 6... / No... 2389.）
37
Supt. "A" Division.

The "informer" reports that there is a possibility
of the Ullman case having been committed with the assistance
of Mr. Blum, the Manager, in the following manner:
Ullman & Co.'s liquidation sale has lasted for over
two months and they cannot get rid of their stock. Mr.
Blum, who is a member of the French Municipal Council acted
as a medium between the gambling and narcotic clique and the
French Police and Councillors in the French Concession.
About six months ago he lost this position and incidently
an important source of revenue. Mr. Blum and Alfonso, a
corrupt ex-officer of the French Police, are very good
friends. It is suggested that Blum took Alfonso into his confidence
and Alfonso hired Stoilov and Bogdanoff to do the job.
Blum, however, suspecting that Stoilov and Bogdanoff might
talk too much when they got inside looked by the array of
diamond rings and watches in the safe. As an alternative
to this he suggests that if Blum was not in the know Alfonso
visited the shop under the pretext of seeing Blum in order
to get the lay out. He further suggests that Stoilov and
Bogdanoff were inside and as soon as the job was over Stoilov
sent his suit to the wash.
（批：The finger prints were not made by either of these two men F.B.）
Rosenbaum, he thinks, had nothing to do with the
case but at the most possibly supplied funds to carry on.
Adamsky, he also states, knows nothing as he is
known as a police informer to every crook in Shanghai and
is not trusted.
Selman may be in it but is a pick-pocket and not on
good enough terms with Stoilov and Bogdanoff to be trusted.
He thinks that one of the men who was seen walking
on Nanking Road while the job was being done was Veltman,
known to D.I. Schmidt. The employee of Boyes Bassett, Lu
Wei Fah may be able to identify him.
page_data.zh:
（印：犯罪组 / 高级警员 6... / 编号... 2389。）
37
“A”分区督察。

“线人”报告称，乌尔曼（Ullman）一案有可能是在经理布鲁姆（Blum）先生的协助下实施的，具体方式如下：
乌尔曼公司的清仓甩卖已持续两个多月，但库存仍未售罄。布鲁姆先生身为法国公董局董事，曾在法租界充当赌博与毒品团伙同法国警察及董事之间的中间人。约六个月前，他失去了这一职位，同时也失去了一项重要的收入来源。布鲁姆与一名腐败的前法国警察军官阿方索（Alfonso）交情甚笃。据推测，布鲁姆向阿方索吐露了内情，随后阿方索雇佣了斯托伊洛夫（Stoilov）和博格达诺夫（Bogdanoff）来实施作案。然而，布鲁姆怀疑斯托伊洛夫和博格达诺夫在进入店内看到保险箱里陈列的大量钻石戒指和手表后可能会多嘴。作为另一种可能性，他提出如果布鲁姆并不知情，那么阿方索可能是以探望布鲁姆为借口前往店铺，以便摸清布局。他还推测，斯托伊洛夫和博格达诺夫当时就在店内，且作案刚一结束，斯托伊洛夫就将他的西装送去清洗。
（批注：指纹并非由这两人中的任何一人留下 F.B.）
他认为，罗森鲍姆（Rosenbaum）与此案无关，顶多可能提供了资金以维持行动。
他还表示，亚当斯基（Adamsky）对此一无所知，因为上海的所有罪犯都知道他是警方线人，因此不受信任。
塞尔曼（Selman）可能参与其中，但他是个扒手，与斯托伊洛夫和博格达诺夫的关系不够好，不足以获得信任。
他认为，在作案期间被人看见在南京路上行走的人之一是费尔特曼（Veltman），施密特（Schmidt）侦探督察认识此人。博伊斯·巴塞特（Boyes Bassett）公司的雇员卢伟发（Lu Wei Fah）或许能够指认他。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
Private & Confidential.
REPORT
Central Station,
Date October 9th, 1929.
Subject (in full) L. Blum.
Made by D. I. Hunter, Forwarded by
Mr. L. Blum, Manager of Ullmann & Co., Jewellers No. 118
Nanking Road, is a French Citizen, a Councilor and Member of the
French Municipal Council, and for a number of years been connec-
ted with Jeweller Firm of Ullmann & Co. at above address.
It is rumoured that some time ago he had some difference
of opinion with other Members of the French Municipal Council
over roulette gambling in the French Concession. Contraband was
also mentioned in connection with this alleged trouble with the
other members of the Council. Whether this is true or not I
cannot verify it, therefore it must be treated with the strictest
confidence.
I also learned that the Firm of Ullmann & Co. ( Tientsin
Branch ) had a similar burglary some months ago when in liquida-
tion, it was reported that some $50,000.00 worth of jewellery
was stolen from the Tientsin Branch which was also covered by
insurance.
It is worthy of note that when the recent burglary
occurred that the Shanghai Branch were having a liquidation sale.
Supt. Conduit. Notice.
R.C.
D. I.

上海公共租界警务处。
档案号
私人及机密。
报告
中央巡捕房，
日期：1929年10月9日。
主题（全称） L. 布鲁姆（L. Blum）。
制作人：侦探督察亨特（D. I. Hunter），转发人
L. 布鲁姆先生，南京路118号珠宝商乌尔曼公司（Ullmann & Co.）经理，系法国公民、法国公董局董事及成员，多年来一直与位于上述地址的乌尔曼珠宝公司有关联。
有谣言称，前段时间他与其他法国公董局成员就法租界的轮盘赌赌博问题存在意见分歧。据称在与理事会其他成员的这起纠纷中还提到了走私违禁品之事。此事是否属实我无法核实，因此必须严格保密。
我还获悉，乌尔曼公司（天津分行）在几个月前清仓时也发生过类似的入室盗窃案，据报道，天津分行被盗价值约50,000.00美元的珠宝，该损失亦由保险承保。
值得注意的是，最近这次入室盗窃案发生时，上海分行正在进行清仓甩卖。
康杜伊特（Conduit）督察知悉。
R.C.
侦探督察
